outputs.explanation: Lower graph in panel A is a bar chart (HMGB1 signal intensity, Nuc/Cyto) shown as mean ± SD without overlaid individual data points.
Lower graph in panel B is a bar chart (% aggregate-positive Purkinje cells) shown as mean ± SD without overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image with no accompanying quantification plot.
Panel D is a line plot (rotarod performance over weeks), a plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days), a plot type exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a line plot exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel G shows only micrograph images (histology), with no plot component.

Both graphs in panel H (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) are bar charts shown as mean ± SD without overlaid individual data points, despite being derived from only n=9 mice per group (N=3, n=9), where individual values would be informative.
